system.description:
Your chakra twists and forms into a long dragon made of pure lightning, This dragon flies in a straight line of your choice. This creature occupies a space 10 feet wide and extends up to 90 feet. Creatures in the path of this dragon must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d10 lightning damage and being Blinded and Deafened for the next minute on a failed save, or takes half as much damage on a successful save.

Overcharge. The dragon remains on the field as a large lightning construct, using the Lightning Dragon stat block. The Lightning Dragon has its listed statistics found on its stat block in the Summon Stat Blocks section and use your Ninjutsu attack bonus or Ninjutsu Save DC when an effect calls for it. You can command them as a Bonus action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d10.
